critic.fix_suggestion: Replace the continuous dark band along the fuselage with an array of 40 small rectangular boxes (dimensions: 0.5m x 0.3m). Position these boxes in a linear path along the longitudinal axis of the cylinder, spaced at regular intervals of 1.2m from center to center, ensuring they are recessed by 0.05m into the fuselage surface.
